div.head: Forf 3.2
div.ab: Si uero aliter inueniatur occultum, tunc potest forfang esse minoris precii, quia minori fuit periculo conquisitum.
Gyf hit ðonne elles on hydelse funden sy, ðonne mæg þæt forfangfeoh leohtre beon, forðam bið on læsse plihte begytan.
If [stolen] property is found in a hidden [but nearer?] place, then the reward may be less, because it was recovered with less trouble.
Wenn es dagegen anderswo, im Versteck, gefunden ist, dann kann die Rettungsgebühr leichter sein, weil es in weniger Gefahr erlangt worden ist.
If, on the other hand, it is found elsewhere, in hiding, then the rescue-fee may be lighter, because it was obtained at less risk.
div.note: Thorpe supplies ‘hit’ after ‘forðam’. Compare ‘bebodan’ II Eg 5. In B (as in the Quadripartitus and the Consiliatio) Hundred follows.
